metadata.name: Conservative Centrism (One Nation tradition)
metadata.description: Moderate parliamentary conservatism in the One Nation tradition, combining established institutions, a mixed economy and social obligations. The Tory Reform Group provides a starting point, not evidence for every contemporary conservative.
metadata.period: British One Nation and Middle Way tradition, post-1945
metadata.scope: Moderate parliamentary conservatism in the One Nation tradition, combining established institutions, a mixed economy and social obligations. The Tory Reform Group provides a starting point, not evidence for every contemporary conservative. Revision2 is an incomplete evidence audit of this specified school. Unsupported modern applications and empirical causal comparisons are null/unknown. Neither agreement nor neutrality is inferred from silence. Historical or programme sources are not a complete contemporary incumbent-government record.
metadata.phrase: A society preserving constitutional institutions while using gradual reform and social protection to maintain cohesion.
